claims.claim: Existing r2 source admission, reacquisition, provenance, attention mapping, event identity, handoff-failure and projection functions remain unchanged; the new transport operates after WAKE projection.

Delivery reacquires and validates live PR #1200 and its repository, branch and head before mutations. Marker writes target only .ai/brain-wake-marker.json on aios-brain-wake-bus-v1. NO_WAKE performs no bus access or mutation. Identity substitution, ambiguous ledgers, marker mismatch and write failures fail closed.

The exact canonical marker schema is versioned, bounded to 2048 bytes and restricted to event identity, attention family, repository, bounded r2 selectors and fresh_brain_sync_required=true; additional semantic fields are rejected.

Global ring concurrency serializes delivery. The distinct digest-bound PENDING/EMITTED ledger provides replay NOOP, recovery before or after marker writes, and blocking of unrelated events while delivery remains PENDING.
contents:write exists only on the ring job, which uses github.token. Source workflows remain unchanged, and no additional credential or external relay was introduced.

Focused regression cases cover new delivery, NO_WAKE, exact replay, PENDING recovery, write-failure windows, unrelated-event blocking, ambiguous ledgers, PR/head substitution, marker confinement and preservation of r2 projection behavior.

Workflow comments and delivery documentation identify real autonomous Work wake/ACK as a separate post-publication conformance gate and direct failures to Human/Brain architecture review without credential fallback.
